1017.name: FIRST_OF_YEAR

1021.name: TAXON_CONFER_SPECIES

1023.name: TAXON_ERROR

1024.name: TAXON_HOMONYM

1025.name: TAXON_INDETERMINATE_SPECIES

1029.name: TAXON_QUESTION_SPECIES

2027.name: PRESUMED_NEGATED_LATITUDE
2027.description: Record appears to be referencing a location in the wrong hemisphere

2029.description: A (partial) invalid date is given, such as a non existing date, zero month, etc.

2030.name: RECORDED_DATE_UNLIKELY
2030.description: The recorded date is highly unlikely, falling either into the future or representing a very old date before 1600 thus predating modern taxonomy

2031.description: Matching to the taxonomic backbone can only be done using a fuzzy, non exact match.

2032.name: TAXON_MATCH_HIGHERRANK
2032.description: Matching to the taxonomic backbone can only be done on a higher rank and not the scientific name

2033.name: TAXON_MATCH_AGGREGATE
2033.description: Matching to the taxonomic backbone can only be done on a species level, but the occurrence was in fact considered a broader species aggregate/complex

2041.description: Matching to the taxonomic backbone cannot be done cause there was no match at all or severalmatches with too little information to keep them apart (homonyms).

2043.name: DEPTH_NOT_METRIC

2046.name: DEPTH_NON_NUMERIC
2046.description: Should be a numeric value in metres

2047.name: ELEVATION_UNLIKELY
2047.description: Altitude greater than 10000m, or less than -100m

2049.name: ELEVATION_NOT_METRIC
2049.description: Darwin core specifies metres should be used

2050.name: ELEVATION_NON_NUMERIC
2050.description: Should be a numeric value in metres

2051.name: MODIFIED_DATE_INVALID
2051.description: A (partial) invalid date is given for dc:modified, such as a nonexistent date, zero month, etc

2054.name: IDENTIFIED_DATE_INVALID

2056.name: TYPE_STATUS_INVALID

2057.name: MULTIMEDIA_DATE_INVALID

2059.name: REFERENCES_URI_INVALID

2069.name: AMBIGUOUS_COLLECTION
